title: Drone Sport Leagues 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Drone Sport Leagues 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Drone Sport Leagues 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 75031 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where racer drones monitoring, league logistics redundancy, or course design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Drone Sport Leagues 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Drone Sport Leagues 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Drone Sport Leagues 2.0 — next-gen professional drone sports.

Phase 1 — Prove (racer drones): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (league logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (course design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (broadcast): league hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and sports-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
